# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price that opens outside the opening range and then pulls back to VWAP while the ribbon is bullish often finds support and resumes the morning trend. This captures intraday mean-reversion within a bullish bias, exploiting the tendency of price to revert to VWAP after an initial gap or breakout.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the first 5‑min bar's close is outside the opening range (high/low of first 30 min) AND the price retests the VWAP within the next two 5‑min bars (close within 0.1% of VWAP) AND EMA 9 > EMA 20 > EMA 50 (bullish ribbon) AND volume on the retest bar is above the 20‑period average volume, then enter long at the close of that retest bar. Exit: initial stop at the low of the opening range (chart‑stop), take profit 1 at 1.5R, runner trailed with a chandelier exit (ATR×3) or exit when ribbon turns bearish (EMA 9 < EMA 20).
